order: iteration outer, factors in listed order, AB on odd iterations and BA on even iterations; fresh context and page per slot, browser reused
historyDefinition: After common centered Select heading and active-element blur: ordinary pointer click on the noninteractive Select h2 versus Playwright Shift key down/up, then common locator.focus on trigger. This is an operational input-history contrast, not physical input or an assertion that Shift changes modality on every engine.
preludeDefinition: Frozen PR34 environment/layout/Button/Badge/Alert/Switch operations versus absent. This necessarily changes other exhibit state. Same product/build/CSS and Select subtree are checked; full-document post-prelude DOM identity is NOT claimed.
sequence: common centered target heading; blur; assigned history; trigger.focus; assigned opening key; wait for expanded and option visible; Escape; wait closed; final snapshot; four-PNG ring measurement
sdkIsolation: NOT_TESTED: prior isolated fixture changes DOM/CSS and uses multiple SDK/Radix interventions. No validated same-Museum single-factor intervention exists; neither arm is sampled as an SDK effect comparison.
additionalSampling: No automatic expansion. Require pair invariants and independent review before any separately preregistered additional run.
